entities.name: Milada Skrbková
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Milada Skrbková was a Czech tennis player. At the 1920 Olympics she won a bronze medal in the mixed doubles, playing with her future husband Ladislav Žemla. She was the first woman to represent Czechoslovakia at the Olympics.
